meta.title: Format selection (and thus format-on-paste) causes destructive edits
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#50082 (Fix trailing formatting edit when range ends mid-token), b7355e30af, 2022-07-28; git tag --contains: first in v4.8-rc / v4.8.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@4.7.4 (2022-06-17) and typescript@4.8.2 (2022-08-25), both behind typescript-language-server@1.1.2 (the latest wrapper release before 4.8.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. A maintainer bisected the regression to 4.6.0-dev.20211130, so 4.7.4 has it.
meta.notes: Format on paste is a range format of the pasted text (the maintainer's trace: updateOpen with the paste, then format over the pasted range). The destructive pre-fix edit deletes from the '}' of the substitution to the end of the line, which leaves an unterminated template literal.

settings_note: editor.formatOnPaste is the client's behaviour (a range format of the pasted text), expressed here as the probe's range_format; FormattingOptions are the probe defaults (4 spaces).

files.source: issue body, first javascript code block
files.note: the file name follows the maintainer's trace (index.js); the trailing space of the line is kept

repro.steps: Open index.js. Paste the word TEST_STRING just before the closing backtick of the template string (line 1, character 53), with format on paste enabled, i.e. a range format of the pasted text. Reported: all text from the closing '}' of the substitution on is deleted ('const TEST_STRING = `${TEST_VAR_1; '); expected: the pasted text stays and nothing is deleted. Probe: the range-format edit applied to the text must not add a parse error.
